description: Fold (SPEC §4.4). Fold `ops` for `group`; compare with `expected`. Tests also fold the ops in reverse order and must get the same result.

cases.name: normal day
cases.note: Members, a claim, three split modes, a foreign currency and a settlement.

cases.name: field groups
cases.note: Title from A (later), paidBy from B, money group whole from B (latest).

cases.name: delete wins
cases.note: E1 stays deleted and out of balances; the early edit of E2 is ignored.

cases.name: claims
cases.note: B wins Ayşe (lower HLC); B moves to Can, which frees Ayşe for C; A releases Can, which B held; A moves from Ali to Deniz.

cases.name: takeover after restore
cases.note: A holds Ali. C releases Ali, then claims Ali. C holds Ali and A holds nothing.

cases.name: invalid and unknown
cases.note: Invalid ops stay in the log but have no effect; unknown types and versions are kept for relay.

cases.name: no group yet
cases.note: group is null, balances are empty, the expense needs attention.

cases.name: member removed
cases.note: Ayşe still owes 100.00 EUR; her device no longer holds her.
